title: JainLLM Knowledge Ontology v1
description: Controlled vocabularies for the Jain knowledge architecture. Defines tradition, knowledge layer, content role, practice, canonical status, entity types, and relationship types used across the source registry, agam inventory, and coverage matrix.

traditions.description: Sectarian and tradition identifiers. STHANAKAVASI is the primary target tradition.
notes: STHANAKAVASI: the primary target tradition for JainLLM
SVETAMBARA_GENERIC: Svetambara material not assignable to a specific sub-sect
UNKNOWN: tradition not determined from available evidence

knowledge_layers.description: Classification of the knowledge type in a source or passage.
notes: COMMENTARY: traditional commentary on a canonical text
TEACHER_INTERPRETATION: interpretation by a named teacher/acharya
BIOGRAPHY: biographical account of a teacher or figure
TRANSLATION: translation of a source text
OTHER: does not fit above categories

content_roles.description: Functional role of the content in the knowledge system.

practices.description: Jain practice types referenced in training and evaluation.
notes: CHAUVISANTHO:二十四층 glorification of the Tirthankaras
PARYUSHAN: annual festival of confession and forgiveness

canonical_statuses.description: Whether a text is canonical, commentary, or non-canonical.

entity_types.description: Types of entities that can be linked in the knowledge graph.

relationship_types.description: Relationship types between entities in the knowledge graph.

rights_statuses.description: Rights clearance status for a source.
notes: CLEAR: rights verified as permitting training use
PERMISSION_REQUIRED: rights holder must grant permission
UNCLEAR: rights status cannot be determined from available evidence
RESTRICTED: rights explicitly prohibit training use (e.g. NoDerivatives)

verification_statuses.description: How thoroughly a claim has been verified.
